purpose: Bounded Stage-1 learnability protocol for generic spatial observation evidence loss, after density, local conditional prediction, temporal-only, and clean-manifold candidates failed persistent Epic fog.

claim_boundary.adapter_quantity: spatial observation evidence-loss proxy with persistent appearance and transient temporal components
claim_boundary.counterfactual_target_role: primary controlled-intervention supervision and operational proxy
claim_boundary.actual_orion_failure_role: independent task-degradation diagnostic or later low-weight auxiliary

reference_data.source: frozen B2D route-disjoint observation feature selection

target.persistent_magnitude: absolute log ratio of observed/reference patch feature RMS
target.transient: absolute difference between observed and reference consecutive-frame cosine residuals
target.target_component_scaling: separate robust q95 fitted on train targets only; frozen before validation
target.severity_rank_activation: only patches whose measured higher-severity target exceeds the lower-severity target

inputs: previous frozen EVAViT patch feature when valid
adapter.total_map_role: visualization and later VLM input only; no fixed governor is authorized by this protocol

intervention_split.optimizer_views: deterministic hash-balanced single camera over all six ORION views
intervention_split.route_validation: same optimizer families on five disjoint B2D validation routes
intervention_split.heldout_family_development: local_glare on validation and held-out B2D routes
intervention_split.native_development: existing exact-pose Epic fog on Town01/Route146 and Town04/Route203
untouched_confirmation: new CARLA-native rain or low-sun condition generated only after adapter code and gate freeze
new finite-window sensor event family not used by optimizer or architecture development

route_validation: each persistent component target-prediction patch Spearman >= 0.30
reference false-positive p95 <= 0.20 after train-only scaling
heldout_family_development: positive score uplift at both severities
higher-severity score mean > lower-severity score mean
native_development: fog_light > clear and fog_heavy > fog_light independently on both routes
paired-delta patch Spearman >= 0.10 at both fog levels
paired-delta top-20-percent patch AUROC >= 0.60 at both fog levels

decision.route_validation_fails: Fix target scaling or adapter learnability before any external validation; do not add families.
decision.route_passes_but_heldout_family_fails: The adapter is intervention-specific; change supervision diversity or architecture, not the gate.
decision.heldout_family_passes_but_native_fails: Synthetic transfer is insufficient; add physically grounded supervision before any ORION integration.
decision.native_development_passes: Freeze model and run untouched native/sensor confirmation; adapter and Stage-2 remain separate decisions.
decision.untouched_confirmation_passes: Only then authorize a separately preregistered ORION/VLM Stage-2 pilot.
